existing_features.title: Implement a purchase system allowing users to buy cosmetic items if they have sufficient balance
Display a shopping interface showing cosmetic items with their prices and the user's current balance
Create a secret admin interface at the bottom of the page that accepts code 2807 to grant £50,000,000

Apply a creative, coherent visual theme with distinct style and color palette (avoiding blue and purple) throughout the entire shopping interface including typography, layout, and interactive elements
Add a tab labeled 'Owned Items' in the top right section of the interface that displays all cosmetic items the user has purchased
Display 'Already Owned' status on items in the shop interface that the user has already purchased, replacing or modifying the purchase button
Update the frontend shop interface to display the new Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics with appropriate styling and imagery
Debug and fix the ShopInterface component to ensure all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items are correctly fetched from the backend and rendered in the shop grid
Debug and restore the AdminBox component visibility to ensure the secret admin panel appears at the bottom of the page with correct styling (30% opacity default, 100% on hover)
Check and fix the React Query hook useGetItems in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to ensure it correctly calls the backend actor's getAllItems method and handles the response
Generate product images for all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items currently defined in the backend, matching each item's name and visual description
Update the CosmeticItem component to display the generated product image below the item name in the designated space, replacing the sparkles icon placeholder

new_feature_requests.summary: Cosmetic items shop with £10 price per item
Implement a user currency system where each user starts with £100 balance stored in the backend
Create a cosmetic items catalog where each item costs £10
Implement automatic income system that grants users £100 every 10 minutes
Add 'Owned Items' tab in top right showing purchased items
Mark purchased items as 'Already Owned' in shop interface
Extend the backend to track and return which items each user has purchased so the frontend can determine ownership status
Replace generic cosmetics with approximately 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetics (finger painter, AA badge, illustrator badge, stick, forest guide, etc.)

Replace the existing cosmetic items catalog with approximately 50 Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics including finger painter, AA badge, illustrator badge, stick, forest guide, and other iconic items from the game
Verify the backend getAllItems query function is correctly returning all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items with proper structure (id, name, price)
Add images for each Gorilla Tag cosmetic item displayed in the shop interface
